body: Large Language Models (LLMs) can turn natural-language optimization tasks into solver-checked answers, but current agents remain brittle under narrative rewrites and often store reusable experience at the instance level. We introduce ArchOR, an archetype-centric skill agent that builds on OptSkills by adding two retrieval-focused modules. Centroid-Aware Representation Learning (CARL) refines the ordering of cached skill representations through a low-rank prototype residual. Signature-Guided Retrieval (S3R) attaches open-dimensional structural signatures to skills, prioritizes candidates by weighted Jaccard overlap, and bounds semantic re-ranking to a top-K set. A baseline-preserving arbitration rule determines when the structural route should replace the original selector. With the same DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone and released skill library, ArchOR reaches 65.00% Micro-Avg.\ Pass@1 across five benchmarks, improving over OptSkills by 1.64~pp Micro-Avg.\ and 2.68~pp Macro-Avg.
